raw:
Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 2
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Norris Bradbury directed the Los Alamos project that produced the first atomic bomb, conflating postwar leadership with wartime roles. This misinterpretation of the timeline and roles (Bradbury succeeding Oppenheimer after the war) arose from insufficient verification and led to the wrong identification; J. Robert Oppenheimer was the wartime director (1942–1945).
